en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Dawood Bin Al Husayn, from Abu Al Abbas, 
(The narrator) says, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the (killing in) error in which is the wergild and the expiation, is it he who intends to strike a man, but does not anticipate killing him?’

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I said, ‘A sheep is fired (an arrow) at, so a human being is hit?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘That is the error in which there is no doubt, upon him would be the wergild and ‘الْكَفَّارَةُ’ the expiation’.
